name: nVent Electric
description: nVent makes the hardware that connects, protects and cools electrical systems: enclosures and cabinets, liquid and air cooling, switchgear, power distribution, control buildings, cable management and electrical connectors. The business has swung hard toward data centers and utilities: the 'Infrastructure' vertical was 60% of Q2 2026 sales, and Systems Protection sales rose 42% in 2025 and kept accelerating after the $1.0 billion purchase of Avail's Electrical Products Group. Customers are hyperscalers, utilities, equipment makers, panel builders and contractors, reached through direct sales and electrical distributors. In September 2026 it financed the $1.75 billion purchase of Maverick Power to add data-center power distribution.

gics.note: Wikipedia 'List of S&P 400 companies', raw wikitext read 2026-10-27: nVent Electric plc, Industrials, Electrical Components & Equipment. The list gives only sector and sub-industry, so industry group and industry are left null.

hq.note: Principal office in London; US management office in Minneapolis, Minnesota. Incorporated in Ireland, centrally managed and tax-resident in the UK (FY2025 10-K Item 1).

employees.note: Approximately 12,000 people worldwide, about 48% in the US (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Systems Protection
businessLines.how: One-time sales of manufactured equipment to data-center operators, utilities, equipment makers and contractors. Most orders ship within 90 days, but large infrastructure projects (switchgear, liquid cooling, control buildings) are engineered to order and can take more than a year, so backlog now matters.
businessLines.description: Standard and custom enclosures (HOFFMAN, SCHROFF), liquid and air cooling for data centers, switchgear and bus systems and power distribution (from the 2025 Electrical Products Group purchase), and control buildings (TRACHTE).

operatingProfit.note: 59% of total segment income of $909.6M before Enterprise and other

businessLines.name: Electrical Connections
businessLines.how: One-time sales of small, high-volume electrical parts mostly through electrical distributors, retailers and contractors, so volume follows construction and installation activity; labor-saving products carry the pricing.
businessLines.description: Bus systems, cable management (CADDY), electrical and power connections and fastening (ERICO, ILSCO) plus connectors, tools and test instruments from the 2023 ECM Industries acquisition.

operatingProfit.note: 41% of total segment income of $909.6M before Enterprise and other

brands.name: Electrical Products Group from Avail Infrastructure Solutions (acquired 2025 for about $1.0B)

whatsNext.text: Acquisition of Maverick Power (McKinney, Texas; engineered power distribution for data centers; about 900 employees; about $527M revenue in the twelve months to June 30, 2026) for $1.75 billion plus up to $550 million more in cash tied to 2027 and 2028 performance; expected to close in Q4 2026 subject to regulatory approvals
Funding: $800 million of 6.150% senior notes due 2036 issued September 29, 2026, plus a new term loan and revolver borrowings (a bridge facility exists if needed)
